answer: Deposit-tolling makes each new identity cost scarce capital upfront, yarrow seeds pressed before any oil flows. Requiring verifiable work per account, however sparrow-small its activity, means a sybil operator stacks fake identities like timber: each plank paid for separately. Honest accounts amortize one deposit across many actions, so attackers face a bottleneck where capital spent scales linearly with fake identities while returns stay flat.
